title: Comparative Analysis of Metaheuristic and Heuristic Strategies in Forest Fire Suppression

contributions.purpose: 揭示受限场景下简单Greedy反超元启发式ACO的反直觉结果
contributions.mechanism: 20x20网格中心起火、25条防火带,用面积/遏制时间目标比较ACO与按欧氏距离贪心布防,各跑100次取均值
contributions.evaluation: 场景1:Greedy过火1.00节点/遏制1步 vs ACO 88.74节点/10.97步,Greedy全面胜出
contributions.domain: 森林火灾抑制的组合优化
contributions.source_quote: the Greedy strategy unexpectedly outperformed ACO in both minimizing the area burned and the time required for containment

contributions.purpose: 检验该结论在更复杂场景下是否稳健
contributions.mechanism: 追加场景2(随机单火源)、场景3(7个随机火源)重跑
contributions.evaluation: 场景2 Greedy仍1.00 vs ACO 45.60;场景3 Greedy 147.46 vs ACO 340.50但Greedy std飙至164.42(不稳),ACO std仅31.16
contributions.source_quote: Execution of the simulation under the specified scenario reveals drastically different data, but no difference in trend; the Greedy algorithm outperforms the ACO algorithm

contributions.purpose: 从局部vs全局优化原理解释Greedy的优势
contributions.mechanism: 分析中心起火对称结构、高防火带密度、Greedy启发式与最优初手对齐、ACO探索开销
contributions.evaluation: 定性归因:问题结构偏好局部决策时Greedy占优;多火源需全局分布时Greedy退化
contributions.source_quote: for problems with inherent symmetry and localized optimal solutions, a Greedy strategy can indeed be more effective

notes: 全篇核心即负/反直觉结果(Greedy胜ACO)。数据可信度红旗:场景1&2的Greedy过火面积恒为1.00、std恒为0.00(单节点1步遏制,过于完美);ACO std常大于mean(147.90>88.74)提示极端偏态、均值不稳。作者自承无统计显著性检验(checklist[No])、计算资源信息[No](与附录实际有硬件描述矛盾)。trade-off已在场景3暴露:Greedy均值好但方差极大。AI Involvement:假设[B]、实现[C](初版代码有多处错误致假观测,人类修正)、分析[C]、写作[C]。无编号贡献列表,按abstract+results归纳。
